title: CogniPilot for Autonomous Drone Racing
execution: Recorded ARM firmware under FastDyn/QEMU; browser renders telemetry and does not execute firmware

specification.primaryPDF: October 8, 2026 benchmark PDF not present in accessible files; verify original document before qualification
specification.geometryDecision: Preserve existing vehicle, per user clarification

matchedQualification.scope: Descriptive matched ARM validation; no superiority, non-inferiority or fastest-lap claim

protocol.scope: Descriptive matched ARM validation; no superiority, non-inferiority or fastest-lap claim
protocol.firmware: Frozen November 13 TROPIC RT1064 simulation ELFs; controller equations unchanged
protocol.plant: Existing 2 kg, 500 mm diagonal Rumoca plant; no physical parameters changed

inputs.noise: Same seed and sample schedule, fixed-hover-reference vibration independent of actual motor outputs; retain binary innovations to verify SHA-256 equality
inputs.quantization: Match BF virtual int16 IMU: truncation, +/-32767 counts; gyro16.4LSB/deg/s; accel2048LSB/g
inputs.attitude: Same 35-degree normal-stick map; +/-0.035-degree quantization tolerance; fixed yaw=0
inputs.acro: Outside primary figure-eight qualification; historical nominal10deg/s discrepancy is preserved and not relabeled matched

tuning.requalification: Four fresh 5-degree signed roll/pitch probes per stack, realistic seed1, fresh hover per probe
tuning.action_if_failed: Retain failure; do not call inherited tuning ARM-qualified. Fixed-gain baseline comparisons remain diagnostic.

gates.course: one ordered figure-eight, full extents and center return

protocol.scoring: Post-step ground-truth vs held100Hz reference at8000Hz, t25 through lap_end inclusive; binary raw scoring samples retained for independent recalculation
protocol.failures: Retain all attempts. A timeout is an infrastructure failure, never a performance boundary.

metrics.integrated_orientation_scope: generated FF, zero position/velocity/orientation state error and fixed heading; reference-force derivatives only; not general closed-loop stability
pending_gates: stock ANGLE/ATTITUDE hover and step tests
closed-loop takeoff, square, figure eight and landing
metrics.precision: generated IEEE float32 versus f64 analytic oracle; not formal floating-point proof

exactLoop.scope: Numerical validation of the exact supplied compiled flight library; no regeneration or substitution

nativeChecks.scope: Separate host-native Zephyr image, not the frozen ARM campaign firmware. Valid-reference echo, invalid-ingress rejection and odometry-before-plan.

firmwareRebuilds.scope: ELF entry point, ARM ABI flags, load-segment bytes, addresses, zero-initialized memory sizes, permissions and alignment. Debug/symbol-only changes are excluded. Does not establish physical board readiness.

checks.label: Exact flight-library oracle, derivative and orientation checks
40 s lap: three noise profiles × five repeats × off/on
Paired config, shared artifacts, noise bytes and counters
Raw scoring, input cadence, configuration and commands

sensor_profile.attitude_estimator_schedule: BF simulation TASK_ATTITUDE rescheduled to IMU rate; onboard equations unchanged
sensor_profile.distribution: 12-uniform sum approximation; assumed diagnostic magnitudes, not measured hardware
sensor_profile.feedforward_interface: offboard tilt lead omega/K; six normal RC channels; no onboard feed-forward modifications
sensor_profile.hover_calibration_status: mean commanded PWM fraction over 30–35 s of closed-loop native Betaflight hover at 2 m in the shared plant

input_matching.conversion: truncate toward zero, symmetric +/-32767 clamp; CG quantized at adapter, BF by existing virtual sensor
input_matching.innovation: same seeded additive noise and fixed-hover vibration at every 1600 Hz sample
input_matching.scope: exogenous noise parity; actual IMU values differ with each vehicle response

sensor_profile.motor_vibration: deterministic two-blade harmonic at 2*1100*normalized_motor rad/s; fixed per-motor and per-axis phase offsets; amplitude 0.25*IMU noise std scaled by motor command, assumed diagnostic model
sensor_profile.sensor_and_command_ingress: fresh IMU and latest RC delivered on common 625 us boundaries; BF transport clock ticks at 125 us

trace_format.noise_and_sensor: little-endian u32 tick + six f32 values: gyro FLU rad/s, specific force FLU m/s2
trace_format.scoring: seven little-endian f64: t, x,y,z, ref_x,ref_y,ref_z; 8000 Hz lap samples, inclusive endpoints

report.qualification: Attitude/rate calibration flight: shared altitude control, intentional lateral drift; course tracking gates do not apply; landing gates retained

controller.feedback: common plant truth in SIL; calibrated motion capture in physical trials
controller.feedforward_interface: normal tilt commands: reference tilt + omega_ff / tuned attitude gain
controller.feedforward_reference: PDF commanded-thrust/desired-axis expression; snap derivative holds feedback correction locally fixed; yaw reference is fixed
controller.frame: world ENU, body FLU, scalar-first Hamilton quaternion body-to-world

course.timing_status: Fixed 40 s commissioning course; no fastest-lap or winner claim

qualification.gains_tuning: equal step-response criterion and documented tuning budget
qualification.performance_margins_status: must agree before campaign; PDF numbers are examples
requires: native disarm and grounded stopped motors

mathAudit.scope: Independent analytic and numerical audit; no firmware execution or formal proof

checks.name: Reference geometry quadrature
checks.detail: Path length converges within 10 µm between 10,000 and 20,000 intervals.

checks.name: Analytic derivatives through snap
checks.detail: Centered finite differences at 3,299 interior times; each derivative residual below 10⁻⁶ in its own SI units.

checks.name: Desired-frame orthonormality
checks.detail: Axes are unit length and mutually perpendicular throughout the trajectory.

checks.name: Quaternion integration and refinement

gates.name: Simulator fairness
gates.detail: New frozen ARM validation matches the 1,600 Hz schedule, shared binaries, IMU resolution and recorded external-noise innovations in 39/39 planned paired conditions. Full Acro/yaw and arbitrary-heading equivalence remain separately scoped.

gates.name: Shared controller validation
gates.detail: Generated-code oracle and derivative checks passed 4,001 samples. Five ideal-attitude missions passed with identical figure-eight repeats. Integrating generated body-rate FF reproduced desired orientation within 6.98e-7 rad under zero state error and fixed heading. This validates the declared isolated test, not global nonlinear stability. The exact compiled library used by the new flights also passed all numerical checks.

gates.name: Closed-loop campaign
gates.detail: New signed ARM attitude qualification: 8/8 probes. Baselines: 10/10. Fixed 40 s noise/lead matrix: 60/60 repetitions. A fresh maximum-speed search is separate from this fixed-reference protocol.

gates.name: Scoring and final comparison
gates.detail: Fresh reports independently reproduced from raw 8 kHz samples: 78/78. Loaded program reproduced from source: 2/2 stacks. Fixed-reference protocol: passed. Physical CPU timing, estimator/body-rate histories and a fresh maximum-speed boundary are outside this dataset.

matched-source-archive.classification: Frozen source, configuration and executable archive
matched-source-archive.note: Tracked bases, binary patches, untracked files, submodule revision lists, generated code, firmware ELFs, flight runner and checker. Includes build configuration and runtime hashes. Use together with the source-rebuild supplements: Betaflight requires the preserved November 13 adapter. Toolchains and all submodule sources are not embedded.

native-integration-checks.note: Separate host-native Zephyr image, not the frozen ARM campaign firmware. Valid-reference echo, invalid-ingress rejection and odometry-before-plan.

native-checks-archive.note: Separate host-native Zephyr image, not the frozen ARM campaign firmware. Valid-reference echo, invalid-ingress rejection and odometry-before-plan.
